description: McSill Ultra 5.0 is a storytelling and narrative development plugin based on James McSill’s methodology. It helps users analyse, structure, develop, edit, and refine stories, manuscripts, scenes, characters, dialogue, point of view, subtext, emotional progression, tension, pacing, and reader experience. It can work with fiction, non-fiction, professional narratives, and early-stage ideas, providing practical narrative analysis and editorial guidance while preserving the author’s voice, creative intent, and final decision-making.

defaultPrompt: Analyse my scene for POV, conflict, subtext, tension, emotional progression and reader experience.
Analyse how to strengthen tension, subtext and emotional progression without changing my voice or intention.
Diagnose scene's weaknesses and recommend three improvements while preserving my voice and intention.
